script:
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/data.json" --expect 200 --check qa eq f16 --save F16.restart/header
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace" --auth none --jar qa-f16 --expect 200 --check . contains qa-f16-root --save F16.restart/cookie
control-agent-server doctor
